item.title: Remove stash isolation — worktree is the only mode
item.intent: Delete restore_stash function and all stash-related code paths in setup_sprint_environment. Remove ISOLATION_MODE config and AISHORE_ISOLATION env var. Worktree is always used.
steps: Remove restore_stash function from main script
Remove stash code path from setup_sprint_environment (git stash push, DID_STASH tracking)
Remove ISOLATION_MODE config default and checks
